t: A $(item)Guard Drone/$ is a specialized non-programmable type of $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ which should be deployed against any inventory block. It will import one item to use as a weapon and attack any in-range mobs with it.
$(item)守卫无人机/$是一种专门的、不可编程的$(l:tools/drone)无人机/$，应部署在任意容器方块旁。它会导入一件物品作为武器，并用它攻击范围内的任何生物。

As with all types of Drone, these drones require $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ to operate, and will automatically seek out $(l:tools/drone#charging)a Charging Station with a Dispenser Upgrade/$ if low on air.
与所有类型的雄蜂一样，这些雄蜂需要$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$才能运作，并且在气压不足时会自动寻找$(l:tools/drone#charging)装有发射器升级的充气站/$。

The $(thing)Guard Drone/$ will target any hostile mobs within 16 blocks horizontally of its deployment position, 8 blocks up, and 5 blocks down.$(p)The reason for the smaller vertical range is to minimize detection of mobs in caves deep below and teleporting to them, which wastes air and leaves you wondering what's happened to your Drone.
$(thing)守卫无人机/$会以其部署位置为中心，锁定水平 16 格范围内、向上 8 格、向下 5 格内的所有敌对生物。$(p)之所以垂直范围较小，是为了尽量避免探测到下方洞穴深处的生物并传送过去，那样会浪费空气，还会让你纳闷你的无人机到底出了什么事。

The $(thing)Guard Drone/$ does not care what is in the inventory, so take care that you a put a useful melee weapon in there. If & when the weapon breaks and there are no replacements in the inventory, the drone will continue to fight unarmed, which is very ineffective.
$(thing)守卫无人机/$不会在意容器里放的是什么，所以一定要在里面放一把有用的近战武器。如果武器损坏了，而容器里又没有替换品，无人机就会继续徒手战斗，这样基本起不了什么作用。
The drone may alternatively be equipped with a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#minigun)Minigun Upgrade/$, in which case you should instead add $(l:tools/minigun_ammo)Minigun Ammo/$ to the inventory.
无人机也可以选择安装$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#minigun)机枪升级/$，在这种情况下，你应该改为在容器中加入$(l:tools/minigun_ammo)加特林机枪弹药/$。
